dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Make the store-isolation guard exercise a code path where the real store write (emit_gate_error / completion_sidecar.emit) actually executes, so it can observe a leak — e.g. run an un-monkeypatched variant of the inner scenario, rather than the node whose emit seam is stubbed.
evidence: tests/unit/test_gate_engine_cutover.py:88 monkeypatches the sole store write on the outage path: `monkeypatch.setattr(gate_dispatch, "emit_gate_error", _record_gate_error)`

src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py:144 `emit_gate_error(ctx.ticket_id, "plan_review", cause=str(exc), repo_root=repo_root)` is the ONLY store write on the plan-review outage branch (returns `_degraded_plan_review_verdict` immediately after)
src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py:677 `emit_gate_error(ticket_id, "completion", ...)` then `raise` — the only store write on the completion outage branch

src/rebar/llm/gate_error_sidecar.py:71 `append_event(...)` -> write_and_push -> stage_and_commit advances tracker HEAD, i.e. the write the guard's `rev-parse HEAD` assertion would detect only when emit is NOT mocked
tests/unit/test_test_suite_store_isolation.py:11 runs node `test_plan_review_workflow_outage_degrades_to_unsigned_indeterminate` — the same test that stubs `emit_gate_error`

ABSENCE rationale: with emit_gate_error replaced by an in-memory recorder in the inner run, no commit to the ambient tracker can occur regardless of isolation correctness, so `assert _git_out(tracker, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == before_head` (tests/_store_isolation.py:42) is satisfied for the wrong reason.
dropped.finding: The new subprocess store-isolation guards run the exact inner unit-test node IDs whose store-writing seam is monkeypatched out in the SAME diff, so the HEAD/directory-set assertions pass trivially and cannot detect the ambient-store leak they exist to catch (regression blindness).
scenarios: A future regression that makes the outage/force-close path leak a real sidecar into the ambient store would still pass this guard, because the guard only ever runs the mocked inner tests.
dropped.suggested_fix: Point the isolation guard at an inner test (or a dedicated fixture-run) that does NOT monkeypatch emit_gate_error/completion_sidecar.emit, so a genuine ambient-store write would advance tracker HEAD or add a ticket dir and be caught by the before/after assertions.
